name: Hidden Pond Resort & Tree Spa
positioning: Forest resort of cottages, bungalows and treetop lodges on 60 acres of birch and balsam fir in Kennebunkport, Maine, minutes from Goose Rocks Beach
best_for: Couples wanting a designer bungalow with a fireplace and outdoor rain shower
Families and groups wanting a cottage with a full kitchen
Travelers who want spa time, garden picking and campfires in the woods

facts.text: Hidden Pond sits on 60 acres of birch groves and balsam fir in Kennebunkport, Maine.
The resort is minutes from Goose Rocks Beach.
The resort has two outdoor swimming pools.
Each one-bedroom bungalow has a stone fireplace, a king bed, a marble bathroom and an outdoor rain shower framed by forest views.
The two-bedroom cottages have a gourmet kitchen, a living room and a fireplace.
Hideaways come with a morning bakery basket delivery.
Earth at Hidden Pond is the resort's organic restaurant.
A free shuttle takes guests to lunch at the sister property, The Tides Beach Club.
Guests can pick strawberries or tomatoes at the resort's organic garden.
Each night there is an open fire at the Lodge for toasting marshmallows.
Guests get a complimentary two-hour kayak or canoe ride, launching from downtown Kennebunkport with Kennebunkport Marina.

highlights.text: The Tree Spa offers massages, facials and body treatments and overlooks the birch forest from eight feet above the ground.
Each Treetop Lodge combines a studio and a one-bedroom suite, inspired by treehouses and mountainside retreats.
The one-bedroom bungalows were created with New York City fashion designer Todd Snyder, each with its own theme inspired by Maine's natural beauty.
Menswear designer Todd Snyder put his signature touch on The From Away Lodge.
Forest bathing sessions are led by certified Forest Therapy Guide Jeanne Christie.

considerations.text: Treetop Suites and Treetop Studios are available only for select nights throughout the season.
Kayaks and stand-up paddleboards for guests are seasonal.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
